# Shrinkr

> A free URL shortener with no signup and no ads. Paste a link, get a 6-character
> short URL with an optional QR code, expiry date, click limit and password.

Shrinkr is a single-page app that talks to an open-source Spring Boot backend.
Creating a link requires no account: each link is issued with a delete token that
is stored in the visitor's own browser and is the only way to edit or remove it.
Every submitted URL is checked against Google Safe Browsing, and flagged links are
blocked behind a warning page.

## Pages

- [Home](https://app.shrinkr.in/): Shorten a URL, with optional expiry, click limit and password.
- [My Links](https://app.shrinkr.in/#my-links): Links created in this browser, with click stats and management.

## Docs

- [Backend source](https://github.com/Shiva-Xs/shrinkr-backend): Spring Boot, PostgreSQL and Redis service behind the API.
- [Frontend source](https://github.com/Shiva-Xs/shrinkr-frontend): This single-file vanilla JS app.

## Notes

- No account, email or password is needed to create a short link.
- Short links use the form https://app.shrinkr.in/<6-character-slug>.
- Free with no ads, no trackers and no premium tier.
